title: Low-Glycemic Egg Salad Lettuce Wraps
description: Replacing refined sandwich bread with crisp Romaine lettuce eliminates 30g of fast-digesting carbohydrates, yielding a Glycemic Load of 0.0. Utilizing protein-rich Greek yogurt rather than commercial mayonnaise cuts heavy saturated fat and avoids inflammatory industrial seed oils.
diabeticNotes: Replacing refined sandwich bread with crisp Romaine lettuce eliminates 30g of fast-digesting carbohydrates, yielding a Glycemic Load of 0.0. Utilizing protein-rich Greek yogurt rather than commercial mayonnaise cuts heavy saturated fat and avoids inflammatory industrial seed oils.

ingredients.name: large hard-boiled eggs, peeled and diced
finely diced celery (adds crunch and prebiotic insoluble fiber)
finely minced fresh chives or dill
large, crisp Romaine or butterhead lettuce leaves

steps.title: Mash Eggs
steps.description: In a medium bowl, mash the hard-boiled eggs coarsely with a fork.

steps.title: Mix Dressing & Seasoning
steps.description: Add the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, diced celery, minced chives, salt, and pepper. Fold thoroughly until creamy yet structured.

steps.title: Prepare Lettuce Leaves
steps.description: Wash and dry the Romaine lettuce leaves thoroughly.

steps.title: Fill & Serve
steps.description: Spoon equal portions of the egg salad mixture down the center rib of each lettuce boat. Serve immediately or pack chilled for lunch.
